note: Exported actual aggregate metrics; private cases and raw records excluded.

limitations: Locally unseen source IDs, not identity isolation
Two face swap generators; not all AI videos

smaug-calibration.json.rule: Max validation balanced accuracy subject to real FPR <= 5%; no test scores used.

verispoof-phone-controls.json.note: Additional previously observed telephone/TTS diagnostic, not new cloned-voice test.

protocol.rule: Only when primary has no positive window, run frozen XLS-R/AASIST on center5s; supplementary positive requires >= .70.
protocol.scope: Follow-up on already observed sets; not a new independent accuracy benchmark. No local fitting on test speaker recordings.

voice-selection.json.reason: Higher worst-channel validation balanced accuracy than locally trained head; author threshold unchanged.

cascade_followup.basis: Supplementary threshold has 0/38 real false positives in each validation channel; counteracts observed generic TTS misses; evaluated separately as observed-set follow-up, no fresh-test claim.
